subject: Geopolitics
title: The Future of Espionage
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Future of Espionage.

hook.text: Spy agencies once recruited people. Now they recruit algorithms, drones, and datasets. The spy game is changing forever.

buildup.text: Future espionage will blend AI analysis, satellite swarms, cyber penetration, and human agents into one system.

discovery.text: The side that processes intelligence fastest acts before rivals even grasp the situation. Speed beats volume.

twist.text: But technology creates dependence. A cyber attack on your own AI systems could blind you at the worst moment.

climax.text: Human judgment remains essential. Machines collect and sort, but humans still decide what matters and what to do.

punchline.text: Technology changes the tools. The game stays the same.

quiz.question: Why will human judgment remain essential in future intelligence?
options: AI cannot collect data from foreign countries
Machines collect and sort but humans decide what matters and what to do
Laws prohibit AI from making intelligence assessments
